verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰ ਮੈ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਥਕਤ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਧਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan saran gahe nij ghar mai nivaas aasaa manasaa thakat anat na dhaaviee ||

en.bdb: In the refuge of a True Guru, a devoted Sikh resides in higher spiritual plane. All his expectations and desires vanish and his mind does not waver any more.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੈ ਰਹਤ ਹੋਇ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਸਰਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharasan maatr aan dhiaan sai rahat hoi simaran aan simaran bisaraaviee ||

en.bdb: By the glimpse of True Guru, a devoted Sikh seeks not audience with anyone else. He rids himself of all other remembrances.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮੋਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਨ ਕਹਿ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat mon brat kau praapat hoi prem ras akath kathaa na keh aaviee ||

en.bdb: By engrossing his mind in the divine word (of Guru), he becomes bereft of all other thoughts. (He gives up all other futile talks). Thus his love for his Lord is beyond description.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਵਈ ॥੧੦੫॥
verses.translit_en: ki(n)chat kaTaachh kirapaa param nidhaan dhaan paramadhabhut gat at bisamaaviee ||105||

en.bdb: By a momentary glimpse of the True Guru, one attains invaluable treasure of His name. The state of such a person is amazing and a cause of surprise for the beholder. (105)
